app.name: Softlings
app.tagline: Raise a softling that's all your own

speciesDesc.puddly: Made of jelly — wobbles when poked
speciesDesc.mochi: A rice-cake spirit, the clingiest of all
speciesDesc.cloudpuff: A fluffy cloud that loves napping
speciesDesc.sprout: A tiny dragon with a sprout, endlessly curious

egg.hint: The egg is wobbling… it's almost out

travel.title: Travel
travel.offlineNote: It keeps travelling while the game is closed — come back for the photos
travel.notReady: Not up for a trip right now: {{needs}} too low
travel.footnote: The farther it goes, the rarer the photos
travel.returnBody: These were stuffed in its bag:
travel.awayHint: It's out — there'll be a surprise when it returns

riceBall.name: Rice Ball
riceBall.desc: A short trip, back the same day

feast.name: Grand Feast
feast.desc: A long journey — the best odds of rare scenery

wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
wardrobe.hint: Tap an accessory you own to wear it
wardrobe.footnote: One item per slot — tap again to take it off

habitat.title: Yard
habitat.waiting: Quiet out here… try placing something
habitat.footnote: Placing the right things draws specific guests — they come while you're away too

arcade.title: Mini Games
arcade.capped: Daily limit reached — the excess wasn't paid out

bubblePop.name: Bubble Pop
bubblePop.desc: Pop bubbles — avoid the dark ones

rhythmTap.name: Rhythm Tap
rhythmTap.desc: Tap the lane when a note hits the line

fishing.name: Go Fishing
fishing.desc: Stop the hook in the green — five casts

fishing.hint: Stop the hook in the green — the closer to center, the better

memory.hint: Flip two matching symbols to pair them

shop.title: Shop
shop.footnote: Items show up in the inventory bar on the care screen — tap to use

dessert.name: Cream Cake
dessert.desc: Big boost to satiety and mood

milestone.hatchBody: It crawled out of the shell and is looking right at you.

puddly_caramel.name: Caramel Pudding
puddly_caramel.desc: Pampered so well it's wrapped in a coat of sweet caramel.

puddly_jelly.name: Jelly Sprite
puddly_jelly.desc: So clear you can see light through it — it scatters sparkles when it moves.

puddly_magma.name: Magma Pud
puddly_magma.desc: Grew up wild, with a small flame burning inside.

mochi_daifuku.name: Daifuku Cat
mochi_daifuku.desc: Round and soft, balancing a fresh strawberry on its head.

mochi_tsukimi.name: Moonlit Mochi
mochi_tsukimi.desc: Loves staring into the night, with a crescent moon on its brow.

mochi_tiger.name: Tiger Mochi
mochi_tiger.desc: Full of wild energy — tiger stripes and a fluffy tail.

cloudpuff_rainbow.name: Rainbow Cloud
cloudpuff_rainbow.desc: A rainbow tucked inside the fluff, trailing light wherever it goes.

cloudpuff_drizzle.name: Drizzle Cloud
cloudpuff_drizzle.desc: Carries a tiny rain cloud over its head, everywhere.

cloudpuff_storm.name: Storm Cloud
cloudpuff_storm.desc: Bottled up too much feeling — it grew wings and lightning.

sprout_blossom.name: Blossom Dragon
sprout_blossom.desc: Its crown blooms with flowers, and butterflies always follow.

sprout_crystal.name: Crystal Dragon
sprout_crystal.desc: Grew a crystal horn; its body glows faintly.

sprout_ember.name: Ember Dragon
sprout_ember.desc: A flame that never goes out burns at the tip of its tail.

offline.title: Welcome back!
offline.body: You were away for {{duration}}. Your softling has been waiting.
offline.capped: (Away too long — the excess was settled at 30%)
